column3: Manami Route ・ Rebuilding a Relationship
La la la la～
...What's so amusing?
Although it's another usual morning heading to school, Manami's in an extremely good mood.  She's even humming a strange melody that I don't know...
What's wrong, Kyou-chan? Do you have a stomachache?
Huh? Why are you asking all of a sudden?
I'm asking because you're making a weird face.
Aren't you the one being weird?
I'm not being weird; I'm the same as usual!
The same as usual...
Hmm... Well, that's right.
Going to school side by side with Manami. Nothing is really any different than usual.
Isn't it extremely normal?
Kyou-chan? What are you thinking about?
I'm not thinking about anything.
Really? Really really?
Really really for sure!
...And that is a lie. Because now, for us, this is the so called... Yep.
The "going to school together"event.
Fufufu, you're being strange...
Although...
The truth is, it's just like any other day.
Manami walking by my side is an everyday thing, so why...?
A "galge"situation... In reality, it's not that big of a deal...
Eh? Kyou-chan, what did you say?
Nothing... It's just that I realized something.
W-What?
Without being told directly, it wasn't something I would've understood.
Oh... Yes. I-I see. That may be the case. Especially for Kyou-chan.
Ah. You understood... what I meant, somehow.
Y-Yes. Kyou-chan...
Why, that Manami... She looks kinda sad.
...Hmmm...
Kyou-chan?
It's nothing.
Is that so?... If it's nothing, then all is well.
...All is well, huh?
Manami wore her usual smiling face. Even though I said that it was nothing, she seems to be pleased.
Say, Manami...
What is it?
Nothing.  I was just thinking that you're smiling like always.
You do? It's not like always.  Yeah, because... Ehehe...
Nope, it's as always. From a looong time ago, I had always seen this smiling face.
Oh, right! Kyou-chan. Tell Grandpa about the traditional confectionery display we saw when we went to Kyoto, okay?
Oh, okay.
I was saying that we just have to make something cute too. That's why next time, to try it out, we should make a rabbit!
A rabbit, huh? Seems that you like them.
Oh, h-how did you know?!
No, you said you liked them before. Did you forget already?  Old lady!
I'm not an old lady!  Punpun!
Yup, it's really the same. It's the same as always, like nothing's really changed.
Nothing changed, so there's no worry. I should relax if that's the case.
